'''Alchemy Lab''' is a [[location]] in the [[Inquisition Base]] that becomes accessible after completing the [[Quests|quest]] "[[Dungeons and... that's it, probably.]]"

It comes with a [[Simple Chest|simple chest]], a [[flask shelf]], a [[Laboratory I]], and a [[Study Table]] built by default.
